key_highlights: ASX ends volatile week higher, but rate expectations 'rocket' signalling potential RBA hawkish shift
Housing market deteriorating sharply: auction sentiment crunched, 72% of buyers paused, 'real housing crash' dynamics emerging
Pilbara mining sector booming; Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor among ASX weekly runners
Virgin Australia shielded from oil shock via fuel hedging; Qantas workforce redundancies raise sector concerns
Australia imposes 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres, intersecting energy and tech policy
Housing inflation remains a persistent RBA constraint, complicating any rate-cut path
Consumer sector mixed: weight-loss drug demand surges, EV uptake accelerates, but major fruit grower cuts ~1,000 jobs

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore and coal activity booming; Gateway Resources (GWR.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor (BAP.AX) among weekly ASX runners. Commodity backdrop supportive.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from strong Pilbara output. Gold miners (GWR.AX, NGM.AX) gain from new discovery. Coal policy risk from Hanson's 'more coal, fewer renewables' push adds uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Rate expectations rising sharply; mortgage purchase rates higher week-on-week; ASIC flags short-changing in home insurance cash settlements. Housing stress pressures NPL trajectories.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds or hikes. Insurance sub-sector (CGF.AX, WPA.AX) under regulatory scrutiny. Housing-linked credit risk rising.

sectors.trend: Virgin (QAN.AX) insulated from oil shock via hedging; Qantas redundancies signal sector consolidation. Australia's 'high bar' for fossil-fuel data centres creates policy tension. Trump-Venezuela oil deal adds global supply uncertainty.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, WES.AX, WTW.AX benefit from hedging discipline. Coal producers face policy headwinds. Data-centre power demand could lift AGL.AX, CGP.AX, ORG.AX if fossil-fuel access is restricted.

sectors.trend: GLP-1 weight-loss drug demand surging in Australia; 'dupe' brand consumption rising; EV uptake accelerating. Major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers. Childcare sector in crisis with closures and revenue plunges.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXH.AX benefit from healthcare demand. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) see mixed signals. Agricultural and childcare REITs under pressure.

sectors.trend: Housing market showing 'crash-like' dynamics; auction sentiment deteriorating; student housing at $440k/bed signals premium but concentrated risk. Suburban Rail Loop cost overhang weighs on Victorian infrastructure.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face valuation pressure. Student housing (SPG.AX, VMC.AX) shows resilience but affordability risk. Infrastructure (WTC.AX, IFG.AX) exposed to SRL cost blowouts.

sectors.trend: Nvidia scaling without premium; CrowdStrike best quarter; SpaceX exploring AI data-centre disruption. Australia's fossil-fuel data-centre policy creates local investment constraints.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle. Local data-centre developers face regulatory hurdles. Monitor for ASX-listed AI infrastructure plays.

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty: rising expectations vs. housing inflation constraint
Housing market stress: auction sentiment collapse, buyer paralysis, crash dynamics
Pilbara mining strength supporting materials sector and AUD
Energy policy divergence: fossil-fuel data-centre restrictions vs. coal advocacy
Consumer bifurcation: premium GLP-1/EV demand vs. agricultural and childcare distress
Global macro: Fed policy uncertainty, Trump-Venezuela oil deal, geopolitical risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hawkish surprise / rate expectations overshoot
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities; maintain cash buffer; monitor CPI and housing data closely
Reduce exposure to property REITs; favour banks with strong NPL provisioning; watch auction clearance rates

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy policy incoherence (coal vs. renewables vs. data-centre power)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour diversified energy names (WES.AX, WTW.AX) over single-commodity exposure; monitor One Nation policy influence

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global commodity / oil supply shock (Venezuela, geopolitics)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain hedged energy exposure; monitor AUD/USD and iron ore pricing
Selective consumer exposure; favour defensive staples over cyclical retail

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Pilbara-linked miners on strong output and commodity backdrop
opportunities.rationale: Pilbara boom and Gateway gold discovery support earnings; Bapcor momentum signals small-cap mining interest

opportunities.recommendation: Add to healthcare on GLP-1 demand surge and global pharma strength
opportunities.rationale: Australian weight-loss drug appetite accelerating; Josh Brown highlights top healthcare picks; CSL/SXH benefit structurally

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure via diversified utilities with hedging
opportunities.rationale: Virgin's fuel hedging model shows resilience; data-centre power demand creates structural utility upside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and housing-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Auction sentiment collapse, 72% buyer pause, and 'crash-like' dynamics signal elevated downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds or cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and housing inflation constrain RBA; mortgage rates already ticking up

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid single-commodity coal exposure pending policy clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Hanson's coal push vs. data-centre fossil-fuel restrictions create policy incoherence risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs with elevated volatility. Rate expectation spikes and housing stress cap upside. Mining and healthcare provide relative strength. 1–3 month range-bound with sector rotation into defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA navigates housing inflation without triggering credit stress. Pilbara mining cycle and global AI capex support earnings. Key risk is a housing-led demand shock. Structural tailwinds in healthcare, energy transition, and data-centre demand.
